description: This Java class 'DefaultEdgeRequestsService' implements the 'EdgeRequestsService' interface, handling various edge-related request processing in the Thingsboard platform. It manages processing of rule chain metadata, attribute requests, relation requests, calculated fields, device/user credentials, widget bundle types, and entity views, primarily by creating and saving edge events asynchronously.

classes.name: DefaultEdgeRequestsService
classes.description: Service class implementing edge request processing, including handling attribute, relation, rule chain, device/user credentials, widget bundle, and entity view requests, by creating and queuing edge events asynchronously.

methods.name: processRuleChainMetadataRequestMsg
methods.description: Processes rule chain metadata requests by creating an edge event if the rule chain ID is valid.

methods.name: processAttributesRequestMsg
methods.description: Handles attribute requests by fetching attributes and queuing updates to the edge.

methods.name: processEntityAttributesAndAddToEdgeQueue
methods.description: Processes entity attributes, constructs attribute update messages, and triggers latest timeseries processing.

methods.name: processLatestTimeseriesAndAddToEdgeQueue
methods.description: Fetches latest timeseries data and queues timeseries update events.

methods.name: processRelationRequestMsg
methods.description: Handles relation requests by fetching relations and queuing relation events.

methods.name: processCalculatedFieldRequestMsg
methods.description: Processes calculated field requests by fetching calculated fields and queuing their updates.

methods.name: saveCalculatedFieldsToEdge
methods.description: Saves calculated fields to the edge by creating corresponding events.

methods.name: findRelationByQuery
methods.description: Helper method to query relations based on entity ID and direction.

methods.name: processDeviceCredentialsRequestMsg
methods.description: Handles device credentials update requests by queuing credential update events.

methods.name: processUserCredentialsRequestMsg
methods.description: Handles user credentials update requests by queuing credential update events.

methods.name: processWidgetBundleTypesRequestMsg
methods.description: Processes widget bundle type requests by fetching widget types and queuing their addition events.

methods.name: processEntityViewsRequestMsg
methods.description: Handles entity view requests by fetching entity views, checking relations, and queuing addition events.

methods.name: saveEdgeEvent
methods.description: Creates and saves an edge event asynchronously.
